Definition: a Moabite or Moabitess, i.e. a descendant from Moab
BiblicalUsage: Moabi means a Moabite, one of Moab — Ruth the Moabitess marries into the family, gleans in the field of Boaz, and the law says a Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD, even to the tenth generation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tension is the point: the law shuts the door, and grace walks Ruth straight through it.
